facts.fact: Botswana's Minister of Communications and Innovation and Namibia's Minister of ICT signed an ICT cooperation MoU in Kasane on 7 August 2026, covering digital transformation, cybersecurity, ICT infrastructure, connectivity, innovation, skills and emerging technologies.

systems.owner: Ministry of Communications and Innovation (Botswana); Ministry of ICT (Namibia)
systems.tiers: ministries, mobile network operators, postal operators, regulators
